result.rationale: loading.html.erb adds an unconditional setTimeout reload every 30s with no cap or backoff. When the enqueued RetrieveTopic job fails (e.g. invalid host, missing user in TopicRetriever#fetch_http returns silently, or feed polling never matches the URL), TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed stays nil forever and every visitor's iframe keeps hitting /embed/best indefinitely. The mechanism is verifiable in the diff: the loading view is rendered whenever topic_id is nil, and the retrieval path has several silent no-op exits.

adjudication.rationale: In the new view `app/views/embed/loading.html.erb`, the script does `setTimeout(function() { document.location.reload(); }, 30000);` inside an IIFE and there is no counter/attempt limit or stop condition. This template is rendered by `EmbedController#best` when no `topic_id` is found (and a background retrieval job is enqueued). If retrieval never succeeds (e.g., invalid URL, fetch failure, misconfiguration), the iframe will keep reloading every 30 seconds indefinitely for each visitor.
